items.text: First email to Sarah Haywood: discreet Egypt execution for high-profile celebrations.
Reply from the weddings inbox: thank you; passed to the events team; will be in touch if an opportunity arises.
Thanked them; offered local production, venue sourcing and on-ground support for any Egypt event.
On 6 Oct they thanked us and passed our note to the events team, to be in touch should an opportunity arise.

The practice is marking its 20th anniversary and continues international productions.
